title: Linking Learning to Your Future
text: Responding positively to help, support, and feedback, and engaging in learning to take action for good outcomes.

title: Key Words
bullets: Career Path – The direction your working life might take, based on your interests and goals
SMART Goal – A goal that is Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound
Motivation – The reason or drive behind wanting to learn or achieve something

title: Setting Goals with SMART
bullets: Specific – Clear and focused, not vague
Measurable – Can be tracked with numbers or progress checks
Achievable – Realistic for your ability and resources
Relevant – Connected to your bigger goal or future
Time-bound – Has a deadline or time limit

title: Activities – Engaging with SMART Goals
text: Match SMART letters with their definitions and examples

title: Complete the sentence
sentence: Reflecting on achievements helps identify your strengths and future ________.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Setting clear, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound goals helps you make real progress in learning and career planning
Positive engagement, motivation, and support from others are essential to achieve your goals
